scope: The human system of paid roles, employment relationships, hiring, dismissal, compensation, workplaces, unemployment, careers, and labour markets.
exclusions: Steve Jobs as a proper name
unpaid hobbies, household chores, and volunteering

groups.label: paid jobs
groups.definition: regular roles in which people perform duties in exchange for pay

groups.label: employment
groups.definition: the formal relationship in which a person works for an organization or another person for pay

groups.label: occupations and professions
groups.definition: recognized kinds of paid work that people train for and perform

groups.label: employers and employees
groups.definition: the organization or person providing paid work and the worker hired to perform it

groups.label: hiring and recruitment
groups.definition: finding, selecting, and appointing someone to a paid role

groups.label: firing and dismissal
groups.definition: an employer ending a worker's paid role or employment

groups.label: layoffs and redundancy
groups.definition: paid roles being eliminated because an organization reduces staff or no longer needs them

groups.label: wages and salaries
groups.definition: money regularly paid to a person in exchange for performing a job

groups.label: workplaces
groups.definition: physical or organizational settings where employees perform paid roles

groups.label: unemployment
groups.definition: the condition of not having paid employment while being available for or seeking it

groups.label: careers
groups.definition: a person's longer-term progression through paid occupations and professional roles

groups.label: the labour market
groups.definition: the system through which workers offer labour and organizations seek people for paid roles
